name: GitHub
description: The open pull requests and issues of the repository, with their checks and reviews, each handed to an agent in one click.
author: Hangar

gallery.permissionsSummary: Runs the GitHub CLI read-only (gh repo view, gh pr list and view, gh issue list and view, gh api graphql with a fixed query for review threads), shows two tabs, sends a brief to an agent of the workspace when you ask, and keeps its filters in the kit's own data folder. Nothing is written to GitHub.

repo-info.description: The repository of the workspace's folder: its owner, its name and its address.

pr-list.description: The 50 most recently updated open pull requests, with their checks and review state.

pr-view.description: One pull request: description, checks, reviews and the files it changes.

id.description: The number of the pull request or issue

pr-threads.description: The review threads of one pull request, resolved or not (a fixed GraphQL query, read-only).
run: query=query($owner: String!, $name: String!, $number: Int!) { repository(owner: $owner, name: $name) { pullRequest(number: $number) { reviewThreads(first: 100) { totalCount nodes { isResolved isOutdated path line comments(first: 1) { nodes { author { login } body url } } } } } } }

id.description: The number of the pull request or issue

issue-list.description: The 50 most recently updated open issues.

issue-view.description: One issue: description, labels, assignees and its comments.

id.description: The number of the pull request or issue
